articles.title: 43-year-old retail giant closing down, starts liquidation sale
articles.summary: One more iconic retailer joins a list that includes Bob’s Stores, Lechmere, Caldor, Ames, Jordan Marsh, and Filene’s Basement.
articles.body:
Having grown up in New England in the 1980s, certain commercials that aired during cartoons like "The Flintstones," "Battle of the Planets," and "G.I. Joe" on UHF channels 38 and 56 have long been seared into my brain.

I can sing the entire Rusty Jones jingle, and if you say the words "water country," my internal dialogue repeats it and adds "have some fun!"

If you say, "It's fun to find out what your voice really sounds like," I'm ready to head to the Boston Museum of Science, and even having been to the New England Aquarium, the horns and excited kids begging their parents to take them there make me want to go right now.

Frugal Fannie's, a discount women's clothing chain, was also a staple with folksy ads featuring spokesperson and owner Kathleen "Fannie" Doxer. Those commercials tended to air at night during game shows and syndicated programming, but even as a young kid, I knew the phrase "Get your fanny to Frugals!"

Now, having survived a 2003 Chapter 11 bankruptcy , which briefly closed all its stores, Frugal Fannie's is closing its final location.

Frugal Fannie's starts going-out-of-business sale

Frugal Fannie's Fashion Warehouse, a discount fashion retailer, is closing its doors after 43 years. Owners Kathleen Doxer and Orrin Doxer decided to end store operations due to health considerations, key staff retirements, and the end of their lease with no further options to renew, ABF Journal reported.

The company confirmed the closure on its website .

The owners retained SB360 Capital Partners to help run a Going Out of Business liquidation sale at the chain's remaining Massachusetts store.

In 2002, the company pulled out of Washington, D.C., and Philadelphia, leaving four Massachusetts locations, according to the Washington Post.

A year later, the company closed its Massachusetts locations and filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy.

"Yesterday marked the beginning of the end for the fashion warehouse chain's four remaining stores in Framingham, Westwood, Reading and Brighton. Citing poor sales, Frugal's launched a liquidation that will run until the apparel racks are picked clean," the Milford Daily News reported.

The original location in Westwood, Mass., was able to reopen months later, however, according to CBS News .

Frugal Fannie's shares closing sale info

Frugal Fannie's Going Out of Business sale starts Sept. 24 at the original Westwood location.

"Shoppers seeking bargains on everyday apparel, outerwear, special occasion dresses, fashion jewelry, stylish accessories, home accents, and more will appreciate the mix of recognizable labels, competitive pricing, and the excitement of discovering unexpected finds. With day-in, day-out prices up to 50% less than department stores, customers will now find merchandise marked down even further, offering shoppers additional savings," the company shared in a press release.

articles.title: Costco killed a popular member perk and finally says why
articles.summary: Some of the deals members lost may come back, but Costco isn’t saying which ones.
articles.body:
Over the past few years, Costco has quietly invested heavily in its digital business.

Those efforts have paid off, according to CEO Ron Vachris' comments during the warehouse club's fourth-quarter earnings call .

"Digitally enabled sales, which include third-party delivery, exceeded $33 billion and was an increase of more than 20%," he said.

Rather than build every digital capability itself, Costco has increasingly used partnerships to expand what members can do online.

"Over the last few weeks, we further expanded the ways in which our members can engage with us online with the announcement that our Uber Eats partnership is growing from 17 states to the entire U.S., as well as the expansion of our DoorDash partnership to include the U.S. These partnerships will complement the successful long-term partnership that we've had with Instacart in the U.S. and Canada," he added.

In addition to these added deals, however, Costco quietly, and without any comment, shut down its Amazon-style marketplace, Costco Next, in September.

That's a blow, as it allowed members, like me, access to more items at Costco-style prices. It wasn't a site I used a lot, but it was a worthwhile selection of items that enhanced the value of membership.

Now, the company has finally explained that decision and shared what it's doing to replace that offering for members.

Costco Next was an online marketplace that let members access items the warehouse club didn't stock. It's not a new service; it has technically been around since 2017. But Costco didn't promote the offering, and it was something many members may not have been aware of.

For those who did use it, however, the shutdown was abrupt.

On the day it closed in September, members who visited the web page were greeted with a terse note.

"Access to Costco Next storefronts is no longer available. Please refer to the list below for contact information for vendors with active return policies. For eligible returns and warranty inquiries, contact the vendor directly," the company shared.

That was followed by a long list of company names with their contact information.

Costco Next, before its abrupt closure, gave members up to 40% off on select products not offered in the chain's warehouses. The program featured items from a specific list of vendor partners, ranging from home goods and luggage to electronics.

articles.title: Governo amplia fiscalização de preços de combustíveis e prevê multas de até R$ 500 milhões contra práticas abusivas | G1
articles.standfirst: Segundo o governo, medidas são uma resposta à alta dos preços internacionais do petróleo, em meio ao prolongamento dos conflitos no Oriente Médio.
articles.summary: Segundo o governo, medidas são uma resposta à alta dos preços internacionais do petróleo, em meio ao prolongamento dos conflitos no Oriente Médio.
articles.body:
O governo federal anunciou nesta segunda-feira (28) novas medidas para tentar conter aumentos abusivos nos preços dos combustíveis.

As ações incluem mais fiscalizações em postos e distribuidoras e multas que podem chegar a R$ 500 milhões para determinadas infrações relacionadas a aumentos abusivos ( entenda mais abaixo ).

Segundo o governo, as medidas são uma resposta à alta dos preços internacionais do petróleo , em meio ao prolongamento dos conflitos no Oriente Médio.

O pacote também prevê a manutenção da subvenção de R$ 2,12 por litro de óleo diesel, além do reforço das ações de fiscalização da Secretaria Nacional do Consumidor (Senacon), da Secretaria Nacional de Segurança Pública (Senasp) e da Agência Nacional do Petróleo, Gás Natural e Biocombustíveis (ANP).

As punições mais altas estão previstas em uma medida provisória publicada nesta sexta (25), que alterou o Código de Defesa do Consumidor.

De acordo com o governo, para determinadas condutas proibidas pelo código, como elevar preços sem justa causa, a multa administrativa para agentes da cadeia de combustíveis poderá variar de R$ 20 mil a R$ 500 milhões.

Em entrevista nesta segunda, o ministro da Justiça, Wellington Lima, afirmou que as multas mais severas serão aplicadas apenas quando houver abuso.

"A severidade dessa multa somente terá incidência em casos caracterizados como abuso. Temos casos de 1.300% da margem bruta de lucro. Seria absurdo fechar os olhos para essas evidências", afirmou.

O ministro disse ainda que é preciso diferenciar a liberdade para definição de preços das situações consideradas abusivas.

"É preciso fazer distinção entre liberdade de preços e abuso indiscriminado de preços. Nosso aparato de Estado estará mobilizado para reprimir essa conduta", afirmou.

Governo amplia fiscalização de preços de combustíveis e prevê multas de até R$ 500 milhões contra práticas abusivas — Foto: Marcelo Camargo/Agência Brasil

Segundo o governo, a Operação Carga Pesada realizou, entre 21 e 25 de setembro, 241 ações de fiscalização em agentes do mercado de combustíveis.

A operação reúne governo federal e Procons e busca identificar possíveis aumentos injustificados das margens de lucro.

As ações, segundo os dados divulgados pelo governo, foram:

O governo informou que a operação ocorreu após a alta recente dos combustíveis, dados obtidos em fiscalizações e cerca de 330 denúncias recebidas pela ANP.

Além dessas ações, a Senacon instaurou 70 processos administrativos contra postos e distribuidoras a partir de autos que haviam sido encaminhados pela ANP.

ANP aplicou mais de R$ 700 milhões em multas

Em outra frente, a ANP determinou multas que, somadas, ultrapassam R$ 700 milhões contra distribuidoras de combustíveis por aumentos considerados abusivos de preços.

Essas punições, segundo o governo, são resultado de fiscalizações anteriores e ainda estão em primeira instância administrativa, ou seja, as empresas podem recorrer.

Segundo o governo, em alguns dos casos analisados, a margem bruta das distribuidoras aumentou mais de 1.350%.

Subsídio de R$ 2,12 para o diesel é mantido

O Ministério da Fazenda editou na sexta uma portaria mantendo o valor.

O governo afirma que a medida faz parte das ações adotadas desde o início do conflito no Oriente Médio para reduzir no mercado interno os efeitos da volatilidade dos preços internacionais do petróleo e dos combustíveis.

Governo diz que abastecimento de diesel está garantido

O governo afirmou ainda que não há risco de desabastecimento de diesel neste momento.

Segundo os dados oficiais, a demanda estimada para outubro é de 3,950 milhões de metros cúbicos, enquanto a oferta confirmada é de 3,978 milhões de metros cúbicos.

O país também tem, de acordo com o governo, estoques de 1,970 milhão de metros cúbicos, volume que seria suficiente para aproximadamente 15 dias de consumo.

Desde março, uma mesa coordenada pelo Ministério de Minas e Energia acompanha semanalmente o cenário internacional e os fluxos de importação e distribuição, segundo o governo.

articles.title: Bets pedem ao STF para suspender MP que proibiu apostas online | G1
articles.standfirst: Na última sexta (25), presidente assinou medida provisória que prevê a proibição total de apostas de quota fixa no país. Empresas do setor citam impactos na arrecadação tributária, no financiamento de políticas públicas e risco de migração para mercado clandestino.
articles.summary: Associações alegam que a proibição das bets via MP de Lula fere a segurança jurídica e pedem que o STF mantenha o funcionamento das empresas autorizadas.
articles.body:
A Associação Nacional de Jogos e Loterias (ANJL) e o Instituto Brasileiro de Jogo Responsável (IBJR) protocolaram nesta segunda-feira (28) um pedido, no Supremo Tribunal Federal ( STF ), para suspender os efeitos da medida provisória de Lula que determinou a proibição imediata da exploração, oferta, intermediação e publicidade das bets e dos cassinos online no país.

As entidades argumentam que a MP foi publicada sem demonstração de urgência. E que o próprio Executivo havia enviado ao Congresso o projeto de lei que resultou no marco regulatório do setor de 2023, destacando, à época, os benefícios econômicos da legalização.

As associações pedem que o STF suspenda integralmente a MP até a deliberação definitiva da medida pelo Congresso ou até o julgamento de ações em curso na Corte, preservando a vigência da legislação anterior e o funcionamento das empresas autorizadas.

🔎Na última sexta-feira (25), às vésperas do primeiro turno das eleições, o presidente Lula, que é candidato a mais um mandato no Palácio do Planalto, anunciou a proibição total de apostas de quota fixa no país, as chamadas bets . A vedação inclui também jogos online e cassinos virtuais no país, como por exemplo, o "Jogo do Tigrinho".

🔎🔎Lula também enviou ao Congresso um projeto de lei que estabelece penas para quem explorar, operar ou divulgar as bets e os cassinos virtuais . Ao tomar as medidas, o petista mencionou o endividamento de famílias e o vício de apostadores em jogos de azar.

Governo anuncia proibição das bets no Brasil 3 anos após ter regulamentado as empresas de apostas — Foto: Jornal Nacional/ Reprodução

No pedido endereçado ao ministro Luiz Fux , que relatas ações sobre o tema no STF, as associações sustentam que a interrupção abrupta viola a segurança jurídica.

As operadoras legalizadas afirmam que investiram dezenas de milhões de reais em taxas de outorga (permissões), fixadas em R$ 30 milhões por licença, constituíram reservas financeiras e cumpriram exigências complexas de conformidade e governança para operar no mercado formal, sob a supervisão do Executivo.

Outro ponto levantado pelas entidades é a ausência de estimativa de impacto orçamentário e financeiro da MP, além da falta de estudos técnicos prévios que dimensionassem:

os custos da interrupção para a arrecadação tributária;

para o financiamento de políticas públicas nas áreas de esporte, turismo e seguridade social; e

para os postos de trabalho formais do setor.

A ANJL e o IBJR também alertam para o risco de migração em massa dos apostadores para o mercado clandestino e não regulado, o qual já representaria uma fatia expressiva das apostas no país.

Em outra frente, a Associação Nacional pela Segurança Jurídica dos Jogos e Apostas (Anseja) apresentou uma ação que pede ao STF a declaração da inconstitucionalidade da MP e, consequentemente, a derrubada da medida.

No pedido, além de citar a violação da segurança jurídica, a Anseja alega:

a falta de urgência para edição da MP pelo governo;

que há ausência de impacto financeiro da medida; e

que houve a extinção sem devolução dos valores pagos por outorga;

Em outra frente, a Advocacia-Geral da União (AGU) solicitou ao Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) um prazo de 72 horas para que a Presidência e a própria AGU possam se manifestar sobre o pedido apresentado pelas entidades do setor de apostas.

A solicitação endereçada a Fux tem o objetivo de assegurar que o governo seja ouvido antes de eventuais decisões sobre os pedidos das entidades.

Para o governo Lula, entre outras consequências, a liberação das bets gera:

agravamento de problemas de saúde mental;

sobrecarga do Sistema Único de Saúde (SUS);

endividamento e perda de renda das famílias;

impacto sobre o consumo e a atividade econômica; e

impacto desproporcional sobre a população de menor renda.

articles.title: Dólar sobe de olho na dívida pública e em nova pesquisa eleitoral; Ibovespa cai | G1
articles.standfirst: Na sexta-feira (25), a moeda americana caiu 0,23%, cotada a R$ 5,1810. Já a bolsa brasileira recuou 0,27%, aos 183.477 pontos.
articles.summary: Na sexta-feira (25), a moeda americana caiu 0,23%, cotada a R$ 5,1810. Já a bolsa brasileira recuou 0,27%, aos 183.477 pontos.
articles.body:
O dólar abriu nesta segunda-feira (28) em alta de 0,66% , cotado a R$ 5,2151 por volta das 10h13. No mesmo horário, o Ibovespa, principal índice da Bolsa brasileira, recuava 0,63% , aos 182.325,59 pontos.

▶️ Nesta manhã, o Banco Central divulga o Boletim Focus, com as projeções do mercado para inflação, PIB, dólar e Selic , indicadores que ajudam a mostrar as expectativas para a economia. O BC também apresenta os dados de agosto sobre o fluxo de recursos entre o Brasil e outros países, além da pesquisa Firmus, que reúne a percepção das empresas sobre a atividade econômica.

▶️ Também nesta manhã, a Fundação Getulio Vargas (FGV) divulgou dados sobre a confiança da indústria brasileira, que caiu pelo terceiro mês seguido em setembro. O indicador recuou 2,4 pontos, para 91,3, sinalizando uma piora na percepção dos empresários sobre o setor e suas perspectivas.

▶️ Às 14h30, o Tesouro Nacional apresenta o relatório da dívida pública de agosto , com informações sobre o tamanho e a composição da dívida federal, importantes para acompanhar a situação das contas do governo. Às 15h, a Secretaria de Comércio Exterior divulga a balança comercial da quarta semana de setembro, com os dados mais recentes de exportações e importações do país.

▶️ No cenário político, os investidores também aguardam a divulgação de uma nova pesquisa da Quaest sobre a corrida presidencial , contratada pela Globo e pelo jornal O Globo. É o último levantamento antes do debate da Globo, na quinta-feira (1º), e o primeiro após a proibição das bets .

▶️ No exterior, os mercados acompanham falas de dirigentes do Federal Reserve ( Fed ) , o banco central dos EUA, além das tensões entre Estados Unidos e Irã. O foco está nos possíveis impactos sobre o petróleo, cujo preço pode influenciar a inflação e os mercados globais.

Veja abaixo mais detalhes do dia no mercado.

O mercado financeiro aumentou a previsão de inflação para 2026 , de 4,92% para 4,99%, e reduziu a expectativa de crescimento da economia , de 1,88% para 1,86%, segundo o Boletim Focus.

Inflação em 2027 : a previsão subiu levemente, de 4,30% para 4,31%;

PIB em 2027 : a expectativa de crescimento caiu de 1,43% para 1,41%;

Selic em 2026 : o mercado manteve a projeção de 13,50% ao ano, o que indica expectativa de mais um corte de 0,25 ponto percentual até o fim do ano;

Dólar em 2026 : a previsão para o fim do ano permaneceu em R$ 5,20.

Com isso, o mercado espera uma inflação um pouco maior e uma economia crescendo em ritmo ligeiramente menor, enquanto mantém a aposta em mais um corte de juros neste ano.

Confiança da indústria cai em setembro pelo terceiro mês

A confiança da indústria brasileira caiu pelo terceiro mês seguido em setembro, segundo a FGV.

O índice recuou 2,4 pontos, para 91,3 , refletindo uma piora na avaliação das empresas sobre o cenário atual e os próximos meses.

O indicador que mede a situação atual caiu para 93,6 pontos , menor nível desde dezembro de 2025. Já as expectativas para os próximos meses recuaram para 89,2 pontos, o menor patamar desde novembro de 2025.

🤔 O que explica a queda? Segundo a FGV, a queda está relacionada a sinais de menor demanda e aumento dos estoques, que podem levar as empresas a reduzir a produção. Juros ainda elevados e maior incerteza também dificultam uma recuperação da confiança do setor.

As bolsas europeias operam em alta nesta segunda-feira, com o DAX, da Alemanha, subindo 0,33%, o CAC 40, da França, avançando 0,59%, e o FTSE 100, do Reino Unido, ganhando 0,44%.

O movimento é sustentado principalmente pelas ações de construtoras britânicas, após o governo anunciar um novo programa de financiamento para compradores de imóveis pela primeira vez.

🔎 A alta, porém, é limitada pela valorização do petróleo, que permanece acima de US$ 100 por barril em meio à guerra entre Estados Unidos e Irã. A rejeição de Donald Trump a uma proposta de trégua apresentada pelo Irã aumenta os temores de uma escalada do conflito, o que pode pressionar os preços da commodity e a inflação.

Em Wall Street, os índices futuros, que operam antes da abertura oficial dos mercados, são negociados em baixa: o Dow Jones recua 0,51%, o S&P 500 cai 0,34% e o Nasdaq perde 0,57%.

O mercado também repercute positivamente o acordo entre EUA e China para estender a trégua comercial até 10 de janeiro e reduzir tarifas sobre alguns produtos.

Nesta semana, investidores devem acompanhar os dados de inflação e emprego dos EUA , que podem trazer sinais sobre os próximos passos do Federal Reserve em relação aos juros.

Na Ásia , as bolsas chinesas fecharam em queda nesta segunda-feira, após o otimismo com o encontro entre EUA e China perder força. Em Xangai , o SSEC caiu 1,67%, para 3.823 pontos, e o CSI300 recuou 2,22%, a 4.340 pontos. Em Hong Kong , o Hang Seng subiu 0,54%, para 24.642 pontos.

As ações de tecnologia foram pressionadas por novas restrições dos EUA ao uso de componentes chineses em centros de dados de inteligência artificial. A Eoptolink caiu 8% e a Innolight recuou 12%.

Ao mesmo tempo, os dois países concordaram em manter o diálogo sobre IA e criar um canal para tratar de incidentes relacionados à tecnologia, mas seguem em disputa sobre o uso e o comércio de tecnologias estratégicas. A próxima rodada de conversas está prevista para novembro.

Em outros mercado da região, o KOSPI, da Coreia do Sul , caiu 2,70%, o Nikkei, do Japão , recuou 0,73%, enquanto o Straits Times avançou 0,31% e o S&P/ASX 200 subiu 0,17%.

* Com informações da agência de notícias Reuters.

articles.title: Após proibição, mais de 500 novas bets ilegais foram criadas | G1
articles.standfirst: Maior volume foi registrado no dia seguinte à proibição, quando 292 plataformas foram criadas, segundo a Bet Legal. Em 2026, governo já encaminhou mais de 57 mil endereços para bloqueio.
articles.summary: Maior volume foi registrado no dia seguinte à proibição, quando 292 plataformas foram criadas, segundo a Bet Legal.
articles.body:
Um levantamento da plataforma Bet Legal mostra que 543 casas de apostas foram lançadas ilegalmente após a proibição das bets pelo governo federal na última sexta-feira (25). O número considera as novas casas identificadas entre as 18h de sexta-feira e a tarde desta segunda-feira (28).

Apenas uma hora depois do anúncio da Medida Provisória, foram registradas 41 novas casas de apostas. O maior volume veio no dia seguinte, sábado (26), com 292 novas aberturas.

Antes da proibição, as casas de apostas esportivas autorizadas pelo governo constavam em listas oficiais. Agora, elas têm até a próxima segunda-feira (5) para devolver o dinheiro dos apostadores que ainda tinham recursos nas plataformas na sexta-feira (25), último dia em que era possível apostar.

"A partir da publicação dessa medida provisória, as contas onde as plataformas de apostas recebem os aportes dos apostadores não serão mais admitidos nenhum novo aporte a partir da publicação da medida provisória", prosseguiu Dario Durigan, ministro da Fazenda.

Mais de 57 mil endereços enviados para bloqueio em 2026

Os dados também apontam que 57.691 endereços — entre domínios e URLs — foram encaminhados pela Secretaria de Prêmios e Apostas à Anatel para bloqueio entre 1º de janeiro e 22 de setembro de 2026.

🔎 O número se refere a endereços, e não necessariamente a empresas ou casas de apostas diferentes. Uma mesma plataforma pode operar vários endereços, incluindo versões alternativas e espelhos.

Entidades que representam bets pedem ao STF suspensão da MP

A Associação Nacional de Jogos e Loterias (ANJL) e o Instituto Brasileiro de Jogo Responsável (IBJR) protocolaram nesta segunda-feira (28), no Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), um pedido para suspender os efeitos da medida provisória do governo Lula que determinou a proibição imediata da exploração, oferta, intermediação e publicidade das bets e dos cassinos on-line no país.

As entidades argumentam que a MP foi publicada sem demonstração de urgência e lembram que o próprio Executivo havia enviado ao Congresso o projeto de lei que resultou no marco regulatório do setor de 2023, destacando, à época, os benefícios econômicos da legalização.

As associações pedem que o STF suspenda integralmente a MP até a deliberação definitiva da medida pelo Congresso ou até o julgamento de ações em curso na Corte.

Além disso, as entidades divulgaram um manifesto.

"A proibição total das apostas de quota fixa representaria uma ruptura do marco regulatório construído pelo próprio Estado brasileiro e colocaria em risco uma atividade econômica que, desde janeiro de 2025, opera sob autorização, fiscalização e regras definidas pelo Governo Federal", explicaram.

O texto afirma ainda que 31 milhões de pessoas usam plataformas legalizadas e que, nesse mercado, existem mecanismos como verificação de idade e CPF, autoexclusão, políticas de saúde mental e restrições para beneficiários de programas sociais.

É possível apostar legalmente no Brasil?

No momento, a única maneira de apostar legalmente no país é por meio das loterias administradas pela Caixa Econômica Federal. Os bilhetes podem ser comprados on-line, no site do banco, ou em casas lotéricas credenciadas.

Segundas a Sextas-feiras : Sorteios principais a partir das 21h (Lotofácil, Quina, Dupla Sena, Dia de Sorte, Timemania, Lotomania, Super Sete, +Milionária e Mega-Sena nos dias regulares).

Domingos : Sorteios às 11h (mudança recente que substituiu os antigos concursos de sábado para modalidades como Mega-Sena, Quina, Lotofácil, Dia de Sorte, Timemania, +Milionária e Loteria Federal).

Loteria Federal : Quartas-feiras às 20h e domingos às 11h.

Para acompanhar os resultados ao vivo, você pode acessar a live da Caixa no Youtube ou ficar de olho no site do g1 .

articles.standfirst: Resultado está relacionado a incorporação de juros à dívida. Previsão do Tesouro Nacional é que a dívida encerre o ano entre R$ 9,7 trilhões e R$ 10,3 trilhões.
articles.summary: Resultado está relacionado a incorporação de juros à dívida. Previsão do Tesouro Nacional é que a dívida encerre o ano entre R$ 9,7 trilhões e R$ 10,3 trilhões.
articles.body:
Tesouro Nacional — Foto: Ministério da Fazenda/Reprodução

A dívida pública federal cresceu 0,04% em agosto atingiu R$R$ 9,29 trilhões, informou nesta segunda-feira (28) a Secretaria do Tesouro Nacional. Em julho o endividamento estava em R$ 9,28 tri.

🔎 A dívida pública federal é a contraída pelo Tesouro Nacional, órgão do Ministério da Fazenda, para financiar o déficit orçamentário do governo federal, ou seja, pagar as despesas do governo acima da arrecadação com impostos e contribuições.

De acordo com o Tesouro, o resultado está relacionado ao crescimento da dívida em decorrência da incorporação de juros à dívida, no valor de R$ 88,39 bilhões. Esse movimento foi em parte neutralizado pelo resgate líquido, no valor de R$ 84,43 bilhões.

A previsão do Tesouro Nacional é que a dívida encerre o ano de 2026 entre R$ 9,7 trilhões e R$ 10,3 trilhões.

Segundo o governo, o prazo médio da dívida apresentou aumento, passando de 4,05 anos, em julho, para 4,10 anos, em agosto.

Já o custo médio acumulado nos últimos doze meses da dívida aumentou de 12,45% ao ano, em julho, para 12,59% ao ano, em agosto.

A chamada "reserva de liquidez' (disponibilidades de caixa destinadas exclusivamente ao pagamento da dívida) apresentou redução em termos nominais, de 11,89%, passando de R$1,37 trilhões em julho, para R$ 1,208 trilhão, em agosto.

Em relação ao mesmo mês de 2025 (R$1,13 trilhões), houve crescimento, em termos nominais, de 6,49%.

No relatório referente ao mês de julho, o Tesouro Nacional alterou a expectativa de composição do estoque da dívida, com um percentual entre 49% e 53% composto por títulos atrelados à taxa flutuante, reduzindo a expectativa de títulos pré-fixado ou corrigidos pela inflação.

Essa participação já foi refletida no relatório de agosto, que registrou recorde de títulos indexados à essa taxa.

"É o maior valor registrado na composição histórica. Agora vou fazer uma ressalva. Em momentos do começo da década de 2000 quando a gente começou a observar esses valores semelhantes, a gente tinha uma participação muito grande de dívida cambial. Eu diria que os outros 50% da dívida tem uma composição muito melhor do que aqueles outros 50% do passado", explicou o coordenador-geral de Operações da Dívida Pública, Helano Borges Dias.

"Olhando para frente, a expectativa é que a gente possa retornar a fazer superávit primários que é a condição estrutural mesmo para que a gente consiga reduzir a participação de flutuante na composição da dívida", complementou ele.

articles.title: Montse Cespedosa, economista, alerta sobre la vivienda: "Uno de cada cinco anunciantes en Madrid y Barcelona han bajado el precio"
articles.standfirst: La profesional comparte en sus redes sociales algunos datos sobre la evolución de los precios de la vivienda en España
articles.summary: La profesional comparte en sus redes sociales algunos datos sobre la evolución de los precios de la vivienda en España
articles.body: Septiembre trae consigo la vuelta al cole, el regreso a la rutina y, según la economista Montse Cespedosa, también un posible cambio de tendencia en el mercado inmobiliario. La profesional ha compartido en sus redes sociales algunos datos que apuntan a que cada vez son más los propietarios que están rebajando el precio de sus viviendas. El precio de la vivienda se ha convertido en uno de los principales problemas para quienes buscan comprar una casa en España. El encarecimiento de los inmuebles ha dificultado el acceso a la vivienda y ha hecho que encontrar una propiedad a un precio asumible sea cada vez más complicado. Sin embargo, los últimos datos que destaca Cespedosa muestran algunas rebajas en determinados anuncios. "Empiezan las rebajas en el precio de la vivienda. Qué ganas tenía de hacer este vídeo", ha explicado Montse Cespedosa a través de su cuenta oficial de TikTok. La economista ha señalado que el 16% de los anuncios de viviendas en venta ya presentan "considerables rebajas de precio". En concreto, ha apuntado que estas reducciones alcanzan, de media, el 6% respecto al precio inicial del inmueble. Pero la situación no es exactamente igual en todas las ciudades. Cespedosa ha puesto el foco especialmente en Madrid y Barcelona, donde, según los datos que ha compartido, uno de cada cinco anunciantes ya ha rebajado el precio de su vivienda. Además, ha señalado cuáles son algunas de las capitales de provincia donde más se están produciendo estas reducciones. Madrid encabeza la lista, con un 24% de los anuncios con rebajas, seguida de Barcelona, con un 23%. Valencia y Cádiz aparecen después, ambas con un 22%. Estos datos no significan que el precio de todas las viviendas esté bajando, pero sí reflejan que una parte de los vendedores está modificando sus expectativas iniciales y reduciendo el importe de sus anuncios. Una tendencia que habrá que seguir para comprobar si se mantiene durante los próximos meses.

articles.body: Stock market crash today: BSE Sensex and Nifty50, the Indian equity benchmarks tanked in morning trade on Monday as persistently high crude oil prices and a spike in US bond yields added to investors’ woes. Both indices crashed over 1% amid the intensifying Iran-US conflict.While Sensex crashed over 1,100 points, Nifty50 went below 22,800. BSE Sensex ended the day at 72,771.72, down 1,124 points or 1.52%. Nifty50 closed at 22,780.25, down 360 points or 1.56%.The selloff also erased nearly Rs 8.92 lakh crore from the combined market capitalisation of BSE-listed companies, taking it down to around Rs 474 lakh crore.Also Read | Two years ago Sensex hit lifetime high: What went wrong after that & what’s the road ahead?Every one of the 30 Sensex stocks was trading in negative territory. Bajaj Finance, Kotak Mahindra Bank and HDFC Bank led the decline. The weakness was not restricted to large-cap stocks. The Nifty Smallcap 100 and Nifty Midcap 100 indices also declined by more than 1% each.Indian equities were also tracking the broader weakness across several Asian markets, where stocks came under pressure amid the surge in oil prices. South Korea’s Kospi declined more than 2%, while China’s Shanghai Composite dropped over 1.7%. Japan’s Nikkei, however, posted muted gains.Why is stock market crashing today?Iran-US conflict escalatesTensions between Iran and the US intensified after US President Donald Trump rejected Iran's proposal for a seven-day ceasefire along with the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.Speaking to reporters on Saturday, Trump said, "I reject this agreement. They want an agreement to be made under which the Strait of Hormuz is immediately opened, because they are severely failing.”Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, meanwhile, said the country would remain firm and would not back down in the face of the US and Israel.Oil prices jumpThe latest developments in the Middle East triggered another sharp rise in crude prices, with oil gaining 2% and moving close to $107 per barrel as markets factored in the possibility of further disruption to shipments. JPMorgan said it could no longer clearly assess where oil prices were headed and, for the first time since the Iran war began in February, said it did not have a defined baseline scenario for the market.Bond yields soarUS bond yields continued their climb, reaching fresh multi-year highs and adding another layer of pressure on equities. The yield on the benchmark US 10-year Treasury note moved further above 5.2%, its highest level since 2004. The 30-year US bond yield also crossed 5.5%, while the yield on two-year Treasury notes, which generally moves alongside expectations of Federal Reserve rate hikes, rose above 4.9%.Higher bond yields generally increase the attractiveness of debt markets for investors, which can put additional pressure on riskier assets such as equities.Rupee tumblesThe Indian rupee weakened by 14 paise to 95.89 against the US dollar in early trading. Forex traders are increasingly concerned about the currency breaching the psychologically important 96 level against the dollar, with the rupee facing pressure from elevated oil prices, higher US Treasury yields and a stronger dollar.“Volatility in crude and gold, along with a rise in the dollar, limited the rupee’s ability to sustain gains. Going ahead, currency movement is likely to remain range-bound amid global commodity and dollar volatility. Rupee range can be seen between 95.50-96.50,” said Jateen Trivedi, VP Research Analyst - Commodity and Currency, LKP Securities.FII outflowsForeign investors continued to sell Indian equities on Friday, offloading shares worth a net Rs 3,694 crore, according to provisional NSE data.VK Vijayakumar, Chief Investment Strategist at Geojit Investments, said the shift in FPI flows towards the negative side after positive inflows in July and August had become visible earlier this month. The increase in oil prices, driven by mixed indications on supply flows, kept inflation risks firmly in focus among investors.Iran said diplomacy remained the only route to resolving its conflict with the United States and Israel. This came after US President Donald Trump said he had rejected an Iranian proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and bring the fighting to an end. Oil prices later recovered more than 1%.According to experts, the primary reason for prices falling sharply is the rise in US bond yields.Ashish Rajodiya, Head – Commodities, PL Capital says, “MCX Gold (December contract) is trading at Rs 1,50,500 per 10 grams, down Rs 2,700 or 1.80% today, extending its slide for a second straight week. Earlier, the odds were just 31.9%.“Elevated crude prices, rather than boosting gold's safe-haven appeal as they typically would during geopolitical stress, are instead reinforcing the case for further Fed tightening, feeding a stronger dollar and steeper yield curve that both work against non-yielding bullion,” he says.Jateen Trivedi, VP Research Analyst - Commodity and Currency, LKP Securities explains, “Global commodities are trading under pressure, with precious metals under sharp pressure as crude remains firm. Uncertainty around the US-Iran conflict continues to keep risk sentiment volatile. Recent diplomatic efforts have produced mixed signals, with Iran indicating readiness for both negotiations and renewed conflict, while the US has rejected Iran’s latest proposal, although further talks through mediators remain possible.”“Gold is trading at $4185, down more than 2.%, and it is facing sharp selling pressure as geopolitical uncertainty, a firm Dollar and higher bond yields with 5.22% on 10yrs weigh on bullion as higher probability of rate hike prices in. Resistance is at 4250/4300,” he says.How should you trade gold?Manoj Kumar Jain of Prithvi Finmart expects gold and silver to see continued volatility this week as traders track movements in crude oil prices and the dollar index, along with geopolitical tensions and developments in the US-Iran peace talks.For gold, he sees support at $4,284-4,260 per troy ounce, with resistance placed at $4,355-4,388. articles.body:
Apollo chief economist Torsten Sløk is looking ahead to when AI agents such as Meta's Muse ( META ) are empowered to make common-sense money moves, such as moving your cash from a checking account to a high-yield savings account. (Disclosure: Yahoo is a portfolio company of funds managed by affiliates of Apollo Global Management.)

"If every household used AI agents to optimize the return on their cash balances," Sløk noted on Sunday , "banks could lose a large share of the cheap deposits they rely on to make loans, which would be a problem for the entire financial system."

As Yahoo Finance's David Hollerith recently detailed , Wall Street is already aware that AI agents could help customers get a better deal on their cash.

"We see deposit sorting — frictionless movement of excess liquidity to higher-yielding alternatives — as a real threat to industry net interest margins," Bank of America analyst Ebrahim Poonawala wrote in a Thursday note to clients.

Agentic assistants are potentially an entirely new frontier for consumers, and personal finance is seen as a clear opportunity area.

articles.title: Women 43.5% of frontline applicants, but only 13% jobs seek them: Report
articles.summary: WorkIndia Rojgar Report 2026: women are 43.5% of frontline job applicants, but only 13% of postings seek women, highlighting a hiring demand gap.
articles.body: Bengaluru: Women are making up a growing share of India’s frontline job seekers, but employer demand for women workers appears to be lagging, with women accounting for 43.5% of applications while only 13% of job postings on WorkIndia’s platform explicitly seek female candidates.The findings are from the WorkIndia Rojgar Report 2026, which analysed more than 650,000 job postings and 9.8 million applications recorded on the platform between April and June 2026 across 772 cities and more than 50 frontline job categories.The share of women among applicants rose from 40.4% a year earlier to 43.5%, indicating a larger pool of women actively seeking frontline employment. However, the relatively small share of postings specifically seeking women points to a gap between job-seeker participation and employer hiring preferences.“More women are actively looking for work. But the data also tells us that employer demand has some catching up to do,” said Nilesh Dungarwal, co-founder and CEO of WorkIndia. He said addressing barriers around accessibility, flexibility, safety and workplace design could help businesses tap the growing pool of women workers.Sales emerged as the largest category for female applicants, with women making more than 5.6 million applications for sales roles, followed by office-based jobs and travel and hospitality.Women’s participation remains particularly high in some occupations. They accounted for 86.6% of applications for beautician roles and 80.7% of applications for teaching positions. At the same time, the report found increasing interest among women in sales, office, marketing and other customer-facing jobs.Overall competition for frontline jobs also intensified. Applications rose 65% year-on-year in June and July 2026, compared with a roughly 40-48% increase in job postings, the report said. Competition was particularly high in IT, HR, accounts, sales and office roles, while delivery, driving and manufacturing jobs saw relatively fewer applications.Language could also influence access to frontline jobs. About 92% of postings required either no English proficiency or only basic conversational English, underscoring the role of Hindi and regional languages in recruitment.The report said its findings were based on actual job applications and postings rather than survey responses, offering a snapshot of changing demand and job-seeker behaviour in India’s frontline workforce.You use AI every day. articles.title: SiMa.ai raises $150 mn to scale Physical AI in robotics, drones
articles.summary: SiMa.ai raises $150M at $1.4B valuation to scale Physical AI chips for robotics, drones and automotive; Gen 3 platform targets 1,000 TOPS at 80W.
articles.body: Bengaluru: SiMa.ai, a US-India AI platform company focused on Physical AI, has raised $150 million at a $1.4 billion valuation. The funding brings its total capital raised to $500 million as the company prepares to scale its next-generation AI silicon for robotics, drones and automotive applications.The round was co-led by Fidelity Management & Research Company and Amplify Partners, with participation from Alter Venture Partners, Dell Technologies Capital and StepStone Group. AllianceBernstein, Baron Capital and J.P. Morgan joined the round as new investors. The company said the entire round comprises primary capital.SiMa.ai will use the funds to develop its third-generation platform, including chips and chiplets, with its flagship offering targeted to deliver 1,000 tera operations per second (TOPS) of compute at 80 watts. Slated for the first half of 2028, the platform will include ML IP, chiplets and SoCs for drones, humanoid robots, automotive ADAS and AI-powered cockpits.“Our Gen Two platform, silicon software, is now globally available in volume production, and it’s technically leading the industry today,” founder and CEO Krishna Rangasayee told TOI. “What we’ll be using the $150 million is to really build our Gen 3 platform.”Unlike general-purpose GPUs, SiMa.ai is building purpose-built silicon and software for AI workloads running directly on physical devices. Rangasayee said power efficiency and faster application development are the company’s key differentiators.“For robotics, drones, and automotive, those are very, very sensitive to power. Robotics and drones are essentially battery operated. Every single watt matters,” he said.SiMa.ai claims its platform delivers about 10 times better performance per watt than Nvidia’s Jetson Orin platform. Its software platform, Palette Neat, is designed to reduce application development timelines from months to days or hours.“Customers really care about time to application bring up. They really absolutely care about performance per watt,” Rangasayee said.The company said 70% of its customers are now beginning to scale towards production, while 30% remain in the pilot stage. Robotics and drones currently account for the largest share of its business, while automotive is expected to become a major market over the next one to two years.Rangasayee said the company expects non-humanoid robotics to drive near-term volumes, even as interest in humanoids grows. “There is a lot of focus on humanoids, but the real volume is happening in non-humanoid form factors,” he said.SiMa.ai has about 200 employees globally, including around 170 engineers, with roughly half its workforce based in Bengaluru. Its India team spans hardware, software, development software and quality assurance, and contributes across the product development value chain.“We don’t distinguish between the work we do in North America versus in Bengaluru,” Rangasayee said. “The competency of our R&D team in India is spectacular.”The company said its revenue grew fourfold between 2024 and 2025 and that it is continuing to see strong momentum this year too.You use AI every day. The decline has wiped out Rs 17.17 lakh crore of investor wealth, according to a PTI report.Expectations that the US Federal Reserve could tighten monetary policy further have also added to the pressure on equities during the period.Since August 27 last month, the 30-share BSE Sensex has fallen 4,161.87 points, or 5.40%, while the 50-share NSE Nifty has declined 1,310.6 points, which is a 5.44% drop.The erosion in market wealth stood at Rs 17,17,487.02 crore during the period, taking investors' total wealth down to Rs 4,74,36,620.19 crore, which is around $4.94 trillion.Why is stock market down & what’s the outlook?Rising crude oil prices, geopolitical uncertainty and weak global market cues are weighing heavily on investor sentiment.Analysts have attributed the sell-off to a sharp rise in crude oil prices following the continuing US-Iran deadlock over reopening the Strait of Hormuz.Persistent foreign fund selling, higher US bond yields and weak Asian markets added to the pressure, triggering declines across financial, PSU bank, metal, FMCG, oil and gas and automobile stocks.Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) remained net sellers in the equity market, offloading shares worth Rs 3,693.93 crore on Friday, according to exchange data.According to Vinod Nair, Head of Research, Geojit Investments Limited, bears remain firmly in control and the market has breached a key psychological support level."This reflects growing investor caution amid deteriorating global macro conditions. articles.title: IEX subsidiary seeks licence to set up coal trading exchange in India
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: Indian Energy Exchange’s (IEX) subsidiary, Indian Coal Exchange, has applied to the coal controller organisation (CCO) for a licence to operate
articles.body: NEW DELHI: Indian Energy Exchange’s (IEX) subsidiary, Indian Coal Exchange, has applied to the coal controller organisation (CCO) for a licence to operate a coal exchange in India.Once the licence is granted, Indian Coal Exchange will operate as a physical delivery-based coal trading exchange, providing an “organised, transparent and technology-enabled marketplace” for coal trading by bringing buyers and sellers together on a single, neutral platform.IEX said in a statement that Indian Coal Exchange was incorporated on June 1 with an authorised share capital of Rs 100 crore. The exchange will facilitate trades at designated delivery points, enabling efficient price discovery and wider market access, it added.“Backed by IEX’s 18 years of experience in building transparent, technology-driven and market-based trading platforms, the Indian Coal Exchange will mark the group’s entry into the coal market. Complementing IEX’s electricity market business, the Indian Gas Exchange, India’s leading natural gas trading platform, and its role in facilitating I-REC issuance in India, Indian Coal Exchange will further broaden the group’s energy market offerings across the energy value chain,” the company said.Govt formally opened the door for exchange-based coal trading in India by notifying the Coal Exchange Rules, 2026, which laid down a regulatory framework for setting up and operating coal exchanges. The rules aim to bring greater transparency, competition and market-based price discovery to the country’s coal sector.The ministry designated the coal controller organisation as the authority responsible for registering and regulating coal exchanges. Eligible entities will be authorised to establish and operate coal exchanges, frame market rules and bye-laws, and facilitate coal trading.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. articles.title: Tata Trusts propose merging 2 firms with Tata Sons to avoid RBI listing mandate
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: Tata Trusts, which hold a 66 per cent stake in Tata Sons, have proposed merging two operating companies with the Tata Group's holding company
articles.body: NEW DELHI: Tata Trusts, which hold a 66 per cent stake in Tata Sons, have proposed merging two operating companies with the Tata Group's holding company in a move aimed at taking Tata Sons out of the Reserve Bank of India's regulatory framework for non-banking financial companies and core investment companies, potentially allowing it to remain unlisted.The Trusts have asked the Tata Sons board to consider merging Tata Electronics Systems Solutions Pvt Ltd (TESS) and Tata Consulting Engineers (TCE) with Tata Sons and to seek a prior no-objection certificate from the RBI for the proposed restructuring, reported PTI.The proposal comes amid a standoff between Tata Trusts and the Tata Sons board over whether the holding company should remain private or move towards a stock-market listing."The Tata Trusts today, as majority shareholders with a 66 per cent stake in Tata Sons Private Limited (TSPL), outlined a strategic reorganisation plan for the company which, when given effect to, would ensure that the reorganised entity would neither be a non-banking financial company (NBFC) nor a core investment company (CIC)," the Trusts said in a statement on Monday.Under the proposed restructuring, TESS and TCE would be amalgamated with Tata Sons. The move would bring operating businesses and their revenues directly into the holding company, changing the composition of Tata Sons' income and assets.The Trusts said that, based on figures as of March 31, 2026, the reorganised entity would have operating revenue of Rs 1,05,043 crore, accounting for 64.3 per cent of its total income. Income from financial assets would stand at Rs 40,072 crore.Its net assets would total Rs 2,00,158 crore, of which investments in Tata Group companies would account for Rs 1,77,120 crore, or less than 90 per cent of net assets.The proposed structure is intended to ensure that Tata Sons no longer meets the regulatory criteria for either an NBFC or a CIC.The Trusts said the merger would have to comply with the RBI's Non-Banking Financial Companies - Voluntary Amalgamation Directions, 2025, including the requirement for a prior no-objection certificate from the central bank."Given that Tata Sons Pvt Ltd (TSPL) will also cease to be a CIC upon the conclusion of the proposed reorganization, TSPL will be required to surrender its certificate of registration," the Trusts said.The proposal does not take effect immediately. The Tata Sons board will first have to consider it, following which the required regulatory approvals would have to be obtained.Also read: Mehli Mistry to leave Tata Med Centre Trust, his 6th such exitWhy the proposal?The restructuring is aimed at changing Tata Sons' regulatory classification, which is central to the dispute over its listing status.The RBI classified Tata Sons as an upper-layer NBFC in 2022. Entities placed in this category are subject to additional regulatory requirements, including a requirement to list.Tata Sons subsequently sought an exemption from the framework, but the RBI rejected its request in September, leaving the company facing the listing issue.The Tata Trusts have opposed a public listing and have maintained that Tata Sons should remain an unlisted private company. Their boards resolved in July 2025 that all efforts should be made to retain Tata Sons as an unlisted private company.The proposed merger offers an alternative route: instead of complying with the framework applicable to an NBFC/CIC, Tata Sons would seek to alter its business and asset profile so that it no longer falls within those categories.The Trusts said the restructuring would restore an organisational model that existed for much of Tata Sons' history, when operating businesses were housed directly within the parent company. Tata Consultancy Services, for instance, operated as a division of Tata Sons before being demerged as a separate subsidiary in 2004."The proposed amalgamation and consequential steps are in line with regulatory compliance requirements and the unanimous resolutions passed by the Boards of Sir Dorabji Tata Trust and Sir Ratan Tata Trust in July 2025," the Trusts said.Also read: Ex-CJI, more legal experts back Tata Sons on Chandra's reappointmentTata Trusts vs Tata Sons boardThe latest proposal comes against the backdrop of a broader disagreement between Tata Trusts and the Tata Sons board over the future structure and governance of the holding company.The Trusts, chaired by Noel Tata since October 2024, have consistently opposed listing Tata Sons. The issue has also become linked to the future leadership of the holding company and the tenure of N Chandrasekaran, who has been Tata Sons chairman since 2017.Chandrasekaran had initially been backed by the Trusts for a third five-year term. However, differences emerged over key issues, including the future ownership and listing status of Tata Sons. Chandrasekaran announced in August that he would not offer himself for another term when his tenure ends in February 2027.The situation changed on September 17, when the Tata Sons board voted to give Chandrasekaran another five-year term. Noel Tata voted against the proposal, while the other four directors backed it. The Trusts subsequently questioned the validity of the resolution, arguing that it did not have the required support of their nominee directors.The board has also backed steps towards compliance with the RBI's listing framework, putting it at odds with the Trusts' preference for keeping Tata Sons private.The proposal will now have to be considered by the Tata Sons board and would require regulatory approval, including an RBI no-objection certificate.The Trusts said they would engage with the RBI on all aspects of the proposed reorganisation."The Tata Trusts believe that the proposed reorganization and action plan for compliance would be in the best interests of the Tata Group as well as its stakeholders," the statement said.The Trusts said retaining Tata Sons as an unlisted private company would preserve the group's "more than 100-year-old distinctive and unique organisational structure", which they said has focused on long-term strategic initiatives and nation building.The outcome of the proposal could therefore determine whether Tata Sons has to pursue a stock-market listing or can restructure itself to exit the regulatory framework that triggered the listing requirement in the first place.You use AI every day. articles.body: NEW DELHI: “Safety, reliability, profitability and pursuing disciplined and sustainable growth.” Air India’s CEO and MD (proposed) Tewolde Gebremariam on Monday set these priorities out for the struggling airline group in his first Town Hall with employees. Apart from widening losses, AI’s safety practices and alleged lack of discipline among crew are under the scanner since last June’s Ahmedabad crash and then the recent case of a badly rattled Phuket-Delhi flight whose pilot-in-command was subsequently sacked for failing dope test on arrival. AI’s unique internal challenges compound for it the anyway tough external environment — airspace closures (particularly Pakistan), rising crude prices, rupee’s weakness and global uncertainty — which are common to all Indian carriers. Foreign airlines can overfly Pakistan.Tewolde, who is awaiting regulatory clearance from India to take over the role, said India's favourable demographics, strong economic growth, geographic position and large global diaspora provide a “unique foundation” for AI’s future success. “These factors give us confidence that if we execute well and remain focused on our customers, AI can become not only one of the largest airlines in the world, but among the very best,” the former top boss of Ethiopian Airlines, who successfully turned around that carrier, said.Simultaneously he pointed out the challenging environment. He thanked the over 24,000 employees for the change the airline has seen since being taken over by Tata Group in Jan 2022. "Over the past four years, a great deal has been achieved. At the same time, there remains significant opportunity ahead of us. That is what makes this an exciting moment for AI and for all of us,” he said.Addressing basic issues without getting distracted by promises of a flashy makeover, Gebremariam set the priorities for the airline which is trying to regain flyers’ faith.Safety: That “would remain the airline's foremost priority and guiding principle…. every Air Indian has a role to play… people (be) empowered to speak up, raise concerns and report issues without hesitation. If you see something, say something. The stronger our reporting culture, the stronger our safety culture,” he said.Reliability key to winning customer trust:“Our customers should remember AI for its reliability. They should be confident that flights will depart and arrive on time, baggage will travel with them and that when disruptions occur, we should communicate transparently and recover quickly,” he saidImproving financial performance:While acknowledging external factors have affected the airline's path to breakeven, he stressed AI cannot afford to lose focus on financial performance. "We must improve both revenue and cost performance… Every employee can contribute to savings, and those savings add up across an organisation of our scale."Pursuing disciplined and sustainable growth”"Growth is the oxygen of business. But growth must also be profitable and sustainable. We will pursue expansion in a disciplined manner and ensure our people, fleet and network are ready to support it,” he said as AI “continues to evaluate opportunities to enhance network efficiency, optimise fleet deployment and rebalance operations to improve long-term competitiveness.”One Air IndiaTewolde said we are already one Air India Group and we will streamline and synergise wherever possible while retaining focus on customers. “Air India has an extraordinary opportunity before it. If we remain focused on safety, reliability, financial discipline, teamwork and customer service, there is no reason why we cannot build one of the world's leading airlines."You use AI every day. articles.body:
Nvidia stock popped in early trading after the AI hardware giant announced on Monday morning the largest share buyback in history and a new platform for AI safety guardrails .

The $150 billion stock buyback plan is the largest share repurchase authorization increase in history and brings the company's total buyback authorization to $235 billion.

The move is a clear signal to the market that Nvidia management sees the stock as cheap. With a trailing price-to-earnings ratio of around 30, Nvidia is trading at its lowest valuation in about four years. That's even as analysts predict earnings per share will almost double this fiscal year, according to estimates compiled by Bloomberg. Jensen "has so much cash and so much cash flow that even after he makes after those investments, he still has a lot of cash left over," Gil Luria, head of technology research at D.A. Davidson, told Yahoo Finance in a phone interview. "He knows his stock is cheap."

Asked about Nvidia's new safety platform, Luria added: "Jensen is the great conductor, and when he sees a need, he fills it. He's trying to get the whole market to grow, because he knows if the whole market grows, Nvidia is a winner."

Nvidia's total market cap sits at over $5.5 trillion, making it $500 billion more valuable than the next-largest company, Apple ( AAPL ).

Nvidia is expected to announce third quarter earnings results on Nov. 17.

articles.title: Micron 'super bull' reiterates $2,000 target ahead of earnings
articles.summary: D.A. Davidson's Gil Luria sees more big gains ahead for Micron.
articles.body:
There are Wall Street bulls on memory chip play Micron ( MU ), and then there is D.A. Davidson analyst Gil Luria.

Let's just call him a super bull on Micron.

Luria reiterated his near-Street-high $2,000 price target on Micron on Monday ahead of the memory maker's earnings on Wednesday, which assumes about 100% upside from current levels. The average analyst price target for Micron is $1,520, per Yahoo Finance data .

As with Luria's prior research on Micron, it just makes perfect sense.

"Memory is a critical piece to delivering AI models, and that is unlikely to change," Luria said. "More memory means better models, more memory means faster inference, and more memory means longer context windows. Market participants across the board have been consistently indicating they do not have nearly the amount of memory they need. Demand is still surging and supply at least a year away. Current multiples imply the memory cycle is already over, and yet the demand for AI compute is still making strides. The most recent leap is the popularity of Meta's ( META ) Muse, a clever advancement in user interface that has awakened consumers to some new use cases. If a few short weeks ago we were worried about Meta's demand diminishing, this now appears unlikely."

Luria added, "The memory cycle is The Cycle. The related dislocation has to do with investors expecting the memory cycle to be over, while underwriting continued CPU growth through 2030. We suspect the AI cycle is actually one cycle for GPUs, CPUs and memory. And so, AMD ( AMD ) and Intel ( INTC ) continue to trade at 40-60x earnings while Micron trades 7x."

The memory chip market has tightened considerably as demand for high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and advanced dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) used in AI servers continues to outpace supply.

Companies such as SK Hynix ( SKHY ), Samsung Electronics ( 005930.KS ), and Micron have largely sold out their premium AI memory capacity through much of 2026 as customers, including Nvidia ( NVDA ), Microsoft ( MSFT ), Amazon ( AMZN ), and Meta ( META ), race to build AI infrastructure.

Specifically, Micron's HBM3E and HBM4 are seeing brisk demand as they are essential hardware components alongside Nvidia ( NVDA ) and AMD AI graphics accelerators.

The shortage has pushed memory prices sharply higher and given suppliers greater pricing power after several years of weak industry conditions.

Experts expect memory supply to remain constrained into 2027, creating a favorable backdrop for the industry's largest producers such as Micron and Sandisk ( SNDK ).

articles.title: Trump to announce massive steel plant in Iowa
articles.summary: President Trump is set to announce Monday that a Minnesota company plans to build a $15 billion steel mill in Iowa. Mesabi Metallics also recently invested $2.5 billion in a new 7.5 million-ton iron ore mine in Minnesota. The company’s executives will be present with Trump at the White House to unveil the project. The…
articles.body:
President Trump is set to announce Monday that a Minnesota company plans to build a $15 billion steel mill in Iowa.

Mesabi Metallics also recently invested $2.5 billion in a new 7.5 million-ton iron ore mine in Minnesota. The company’s executives will be present with Trump at the White House to unveil the project.

The steel plant could see its first production in 2030, and the eastern Iowa site will be the largest of its kind in U.S. history, according to a White House official. Once fully functional, it could produce 10 million tons of steel per year.

The Wall Street Journal was the first to report on the announcement.

“President Trump is delivering on his promise to rebuild American industry, reshore manufacturing, and create new jobs,” White House spokesperson Taylor Rogers said in a statement.

“Today’s announcement underscores the President’s historic efforts to revitalize the U.S. steel industry—supporting local communities, strengthening supply chains, and protecting our national security,” she said. “After decades of decline, this President is restoring America’s industrial competitiveness and securing trillions of dollars in new investment.”

The Minnesota mine, which recently opened, will create 350 new jobs, and the steel plant will create 1,750 new jobs for Iowans, a White House official said.

Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick; John Jovanovic, chair of the Export-Import Bank; and David Copley, senior director for Global Supply Chain, will be among the other people present at the announcement.

It comes 36 days before the midterm elections. Iowa Republicans face tough races for U.S. House and Senate as the party aims to hold onto control of the two chambers. The governor’s race is also one to watch.

Zach Lahn, the Republican nominee for Iowa governor, welcomed the announcement.

“This is a direct result of focusing on building in America. Iowa is the best place to do just that,” he wrote on the social platform X . “Looking forward to working with President Trump to get this plant fully online.”

Rep. Ashley Hinson (Iowa), the Republican Senate candidate, also called the proposed plant “a game-changing investment for our state.”

This is the latest move by the Trump administration to push for more steel production in the U.S. There is currently a 50 percent tariff on items made entirely or almost entirely of aluminum, steel or copper, while lower tariffs apply to finished or derivative goods made with steel.

articles.title: Stocks fall, bond yields surge and oil fluctuates as war keeps markets on edge
articles.summary: Stocks fell Monday alongside a jump in bond yields and erratic oil trading as geopolitical upheaval remained front and center for traders.
articles.body: Stocks fell Monday alongside a jump in bond yields and erratic oil trading as geopolitical upheaval remained front and center for traders. The S&P 500 ended lower by 0.7% and the Nasdaq Composite dropped 0.9% as oil prices rose, pushing Brent crude oil back above $106 per barrel. Earlier in the day, Brent rose beyond $108, but that jump moderated after reports said that mediators planned to meet with U.S. and Iranian officials separately to discuss the ongoing stalemate between the two sides over the war with Iran. Iran’s semiofficial ISNA news agency downplayed the significance of the meetings, saying that Iran’s foreign minister, Abbas Araghchi, would attend talks with mediators but that no U.S. representatives would be present. Other reports throughout the day that said Trump was open to offering Iran economic concessions in order to reboot talks and reach a deal also took some of the heat off oil prices. NBC News has not confirmed these reports. Over the weekend, President Donald Trump said he had rejected a recent proposal from Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, through which critical energy supplies flowed before the war. “They want to make a deal, and I think that’s fine,” Trump told reporters in Washington. “I like making a deal too, but ... that deal would not be acceptable.” Monday’s rocky oil trading has been a familiar feature of this year’s turbulent markets. Bond yields also surged to fresh multiyear highs. The 10-year U.S. Treasury yield rose as as high 5.27%, its highest level since mid-June 2007. A wide swath of other Treasurys also continued to trade above 5%, and the yield on the 30-year bond hit its highest level since May 2004. The 2-year Treasury, which is often viewed as a signal of where the market expects central bank rates to go, reached its highest level since 2024. Market watchers’ anxiety has grown alongside the rise in bond yields. “The significant increase in oil prices so far this year hasn’t knocked the wind out of the global economy’s sails,” longtime market analyst Ed Yardeni wrote Saturday. “The question is whether rapidly rising interest rates will do so.” “Unfortunately, these higher rates also exacerbate the outlook for large government deficits worldwide,” Yardeni, president of Yardeni Research, wrote. Still, stocks have largely remained resilient in the face of rising inflation from higher oil prices and bond yields that keep shooting higher. Part of the reason why “is that financial conditions have changed little” since January, analysts at Goldman Sachs said. They added that “the substantial rise in interest rates has been nearly offset by the effects of higher equity prices.” But the equity market’s rise this year has been driven primarily by just a few sectors, which troubles some analysts. For the year so far, the S&P 500 has risen a little more than 12%. But a look under the hood reveals a different story. The information technology sector has gained 27% this year, and the energy sector has added 38%. The health care, industrials and materials sectors are up 10%. But the real estate, consumer staples and communication services sectors have all gained less than 7%. The utilities, financial and consumer discretionary sectors have each contracted. On top of higher oil prices, rising bond yields and geopolitical headlines that could swing stocks in either direction at a moment’s notice, the end of the month features prominent central bank meetings, including at the Federal Reserve, where rates could rise further.

articles.title: Rs 5.2 crore cash deposit, but Rs 7.65 lakh shown in ITR: Grain trader wins tax case after ITAT quashes notice, finds bank account was disclosed in Form 3CD
articles.summary: You make large cash deposits in your bank account, but report a much lower income in your tax return.
articles.body: You make large cash deposits in your bank account, but report a much lower income in your tax return. The bank reports the deposits to the Income Tax Department as part of due process, what happens then?Banks in India are required to report specified financial transactions, including cash deposits and withdrawals above prescribed limits.A grain trader came under the income tax department's scrutiny after depositing Rs 5.2 crore in cash into his bank account while declaring an income of only Rs 7.65 lakh in his Income Tax Return (ITR).What the case is aboutThe first alert was generated when the bank disclosed the cash deposit through its specified financial transaction (SFT) return.In this case, the Rs 5.2 crore cash deposit resulted in the transaction being reported to the tax authorities.A second issue emerged from the person’s ITR. Although the bank account did not appear in the ITR itself, it was disclosed in the Form 3CD filed along with the return. The Income Tax Assessing Officer (AO) initially took the view that the grain trader had failed to disclose the bank account in his ITR.Also Read | Her employer deducted Rs 3.91 lakh TDS but failed to deposit it; Mumbai IT professional got just Rs 79,030 credit and faced Rs 3.36 lakh demand, ITAT gives reliefOn the basis of this understanding, the AO issued several notices to the individual seeking an explanation for the cash deposit and details relating to his ITR. The responses did not satisfy the tax department, following which the AO passed an assessment order. Through the order, the Rs 5.2 crore deposit was treated as unexplained money under Section 69.The grain trader was represented before the Income Tax Appellate Tribunal (ITAT), Delhi, by two chartered accountants. They submitted that the person in question was engaged in grain trading and had furnished Form 3CD along with his ITR. The form contained the details of his bank account maintained with the bank.They argued before the ITAT that when he filed the ITR, the applicable provisions did not require taxpayers to provide details of bank accounts other than the account into which an income tax refund was to be credited.The individual had therefore believed that there would be no issue because the bank account had already been disclosed in the balance sheet attached to Form 3CD. The AO, however, treated the absence of the account details from the ITR as a significant issue and proceeded on the assumption that the man had failed to disclose the account, according to an ET report.The argument by the chartered accounts was that this conclusion was factually incorrect because the bank account had in fact been disclosed and formed part of the balance sheet. Therefore, the AO's conclusion that the amount represented escaped income could not be sustained on the basis that the account had not been disclosed, they said.On September 15, 2026, the ITAT Delhi ruled in the grain trader’s favour.Also Read | Delhi couple repaid Rs 1.41 crore home loan, but the bank lost their original sale deed property papers; consumer commission orders Rs 15 lakh compensation plus Rs 50,000 costsWhy did the grain trader win the case?While examining the ITR, the ITAT Delhi found that the bank account details had been provided through Form 3CD.The tribunal said: “We further find that the bank account of Allahabad Bank has been duly disclosed in the ITR vide Form 3CD which give details of all bank accounts.”Based on this finding, the ITAT Delhi held that the reasons recorded for reopening the case were founded on incorrect facts. This, in turn, vitiated the assumption of jurisdiction through the notice issued under Section 148.The tribunal therefore quashed the tax notice as well as the assessment order that was subsequently passed.Advocate Somesh Jain of Sachdev & Jain, Advocates, told ET that the grain trader’s success before the tribunal was based on a jurisdictional issue rather than the merits of the cash deposits themselves.He said a reassessment can be initiated validly only when the reasons recorded by the Assessing Officer are based on accurate facts. In this case, the recorded reasons proceeded on the premise that the man had not disclosed his bank account in his income tax return.The ITAT Delhi examined the individual’s ITR for AY 2014-15 and found that the return had been accompanied by the tax audit report in Form 3CD, which contained details of the bank account.Jain said that once the basic fact underlying the reasons for reopening was found to be incorrect, the assumption of jurisdiction under Sections 147/148, as applicable at the time, was affected. Consequently, the notice issued under these provisions, along with the assessment order that followed it, could not stand.Akhil Chandna, Partner, Global People Solutions Leader, Grant Thornton Bharat, told ET that agricultural income is generally exempt from tax. However, where the applicable ITR form requires it, the income still needs to be disclosed appropriately in the return.The ITR forms have designated fields and schedules for reporting exempt income, including agricultural income. Such reporting can also become relevant when agricultural income is taken into account for partial integration while determining the tax rate applicable to non-agricultural income.Chandna says: "As a matter of good tax compliance, agricultural income should be appropriately and consistently disclosed in the ITR wherever required by the applicable form."You use AI every day. articles.title: Gautam Adani, 4 group firms settle with Sebi in minimum public shareholding violation case
articles.summary: NEW DELHI: Adani Group chairman Gautam Adani, four group companies and 13 others have settled proceedings with the Securities and Exchange Board of India
articles.body: NEW DELHI: Adani Group chairman Gautam Adani, four group companies and 13 others have settled proceedings with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) over alleged non-compliance with minimum public shareholding (MPS) requirements by paying a combined Rs 1.48 crore, according to a settlement order passed by the regulator on Monday.The settlement covers Adani Enterprises Ltd, Adani Power Ltd, Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Ltd (APSEZ), and Adani Transmission Ltd, now known as Adani Energy Solutions Ltd, along with their directors and certain other officials.Under the settlement terms, each of the four groups was required to pay Rs 37.05 lakh jointly and severally, taking the total settlement amount to Rs 1.482 crore. The applicants paid the amounts on August 26, the order said.The applicants proposed to settle the proceedings “without admitting or denying the facts and conclusions of law”, the order said.Following the settlement, Sebi whole-time member Kamlesh Chandra Varshney directed that the proceedings against the applicants be disposed of. The order said “SEBI shall not initiate any other enforcement action against Applicants for the violations as alleged in the SCN.”However, Sebi retained the right to restore or initiate proceedings if representations made during the settlement process are subsequently found to be untrue, if the applicants breach conditions or undertakings given as part of the settlement, or if there was a discrepancy in arriving at the settlement terms.The proceedings date back to complaints received by Sebi in June and July 2020 alleging, among other things, non-compliance with MPS requirements by certain listed Adani Group companies.
